tracked_patterns.name: Liquidity Sweep
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price dropped below recent range support near 555 to approximately 552.5, then reversed with strong bullish candles back toward 560, consistent with a liquidity sweep below range lows.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmation of sustained reclaim above 555 and breakout above range high at 560-562.5

tracked_patterns.name: Double Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Two distinct swing highs visible near 561-562 with an intervening trough around 557-558. Current price at 556.51 has declined below the neckline area.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmation candle close below neckline and sustained downside follow-through.

tracked_patterns.name: Symmetrical Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent price action shows converging swings with lower highs near 561 and higher lows near 555-557, forming a contracting range near recent highs.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: A clear breakout above resistance or below support is needed to confirm the triangle and establish directional bias.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish breakdown below 555 to bullish reversal, with price reclaiming the 555 level and approaching the 560-562.5 swing high.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above 562.5 to confirm bullish CHoCH; failure to hold above 555 would invalidate

tracked_patterns.name: Bullish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp upward move from approximately 552.5 to 561 followed by tight sideways consolidation between roughly 555 and 561.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above flag resistance near 561 to confirm continuation.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish market structure with higher highs and higher lows has been disrupted by a lower high and breakdown below recent swing low structure.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear bearish Break of Structure (BOS) with a close below the structural low to confirm bearish shift.

tracked_patterns.name: Bearish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp rally to ~562 followed by downward-sloping consolidation near resistance with declining momentum.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear breakdown below the flag support trendline to confirm bearish continuation.

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Follow-through breakdown below recent swing lows (~553-555) to confirm bearish order flow.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price shifted from bearish structure with lower lows near 552 to a strong bullish break above 560 accompanied by elevated volume near 08:15.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Bottom
tracked_patterns.evidence: Two distinct swing lows are visible around 552-553 separated by a rally to approximately 560. Price is currently retesting the neckline resistance area near 558-560.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Decisive break above neckline resistance (~560) to confirm the pattern and trigger the reversal target.

tracked_patterns.name: Ascending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Series of higher lows from 552.5 toward 557-558 with horizontal resistance at 560-561

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish market structure showing hesitation and rejection at 562 resistance. Potential shift to bearish bias if price breaks below recent swing low.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Actual break of structure below the most recent higher low (~552) to confirm CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (Bearish)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish market structure is showing weakness after rejection from ~563, with price declining toward the recent higher low at ~552.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: A confirmed close below the recent swing low (~552) is required to validate the bearish CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Head and Shoulders
tracked_patterns.evidence: Left shoulder formed near 560, head formed near 561-562, and right shoulder is currently forming near 560-561. Neckline area around 556-557.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Completion of right shoulder and decisive break below neckline support around 556.5.

tracked_patterns.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
tracked_patterns.evidence: Three distinct lows visible with the middle low lower than the left and right shoulders. Price is currently testing neckline resistance around 560.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above neckline at 560 to confirm pattern completion.

tracked_patterns.name: Triple Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Multiple rejections visible near 560-562 zone across recent sessions, suggesting three potential tops at resistance.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear third peak completion and breakdown below ~555 support needed for confirmation.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish to bullish after the low near 552.5; price is now challenging previous swing highs
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close above previous swing high at approximately 561.5

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shows higher highs and higher lows since the 05:00 low, with price approaching a break above the most recent swing high.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed close above 562.5 to validate bullish BOS.

tracked_patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent strong bullish candle near current price area appears to engulf the body of the prior bearish candle.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmation of the 15m candle close to validate the engulfing relationship.
